module: Stategraph node "Get Transition Variables". Reads the variables passed by the "Transition" node of the previous state (transitionStack of the started state) and exposes them on its custom output pins; the input flow is copied to the output.
notes: work also overwrites pinOut.flow with nil via the loop (self._stack['flow']) before rewriting it at the end: harmless.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

onStateStarted.desc: Hook: on entering the state, stores state.transitionStack.

work.desc: Copies _stack[name] to each output pin and copies flow.

makePinTemplates.desc: Builds the pin templates like the transition node.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Prepares the pin templates if needed.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.
